snippet.title: Vellum - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vellum is Out Now in 1.0 on Steam (after over 22 Early Access updates in the last year - and more to come!): https://store.steampowered.com/app/917950/Vellum/

Defend the books in Vellum, a co-op, literary roguelike! Harness class-defining colors, master an inspired spellbook, and influence the growth of your enemy! As a group or solo, you'll craft plot-twisting builds to rewrite the rules in Ink!

Up to 4 players can sling ink together in a dynamic roguelike full of synergy and strategy to discover! #roguelike #indiegame #fantasy
